name: Acceptance suite-2 test 44 - duplicate JSON key blocks (fail closed)
note: IAM-901: a statement object with two "Action" keys parses (JSON.parse keeps last-key-wins, silently dropping s3:GetObject), so the analyzer would report on a policy the author did not write. Detect the duplicate in the RAW TEXT and BLOCK with DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY naming the key + statement location; no findings, risk score, or graph. policyRaw carries the exact text (a clean JS object cannot express a duplicate key). Original text is preserved so the UI can highlight the duplicate.
